fightLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Wilhelm Lehmann. Musician. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Dispatcher's headset, Seed packet, Busker's harmonica, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.
You remember the Crude bow at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
